import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import (
    RandomForestClassifier,
    GradientBoostingClassifier,
    ExtraTreesClassifier,
)
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import normalize
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set paths as per instructions
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
OUTPUT_DIR = "./submission"
if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_DIR):
    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv")

# Get features
id_col = "id"

# Training data preparation
X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[id_col])
y_train_raw = train_df[
    (
        target_col
        if "target_col" in dir()
        else list(train_df.columns)[len(list(train_df.columns)) - 1]
    )
]

# Handle cases where species might be in different column
target_col_candidates = [
    c
    for c in train_df.columns
    if c not in [id_col] and c.lower() not in ["margin", "shape", "texture", "id"]
]
target_col = None
for col in target_col_candidates:
    if "species" in col.lower() or len(set(train_df[col].unique())) >= 90:
        target_col = col
        break

if target_col is None:
    target_col = train_df.columns[-1]

X_train = train_df[train_df.columns.difference([id_col, target_col])]
y_train_enc = y_train_raw.map(lambda x: x)

# Test data preparation
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[id_col])
test_ids = test_df[id_col]

# Determine output classes
output_classes = sorted(y_train_enc.unique())
class_idx_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(output_classes)}
classes_order = sorted(output_classes)
y_train_int = y_train_enc.map(class_idx_map).values.astype(int)

# Apply normalization to features
X_train_norm = normalize(X_train.values)
X_test_norm = normalize(X_test.values)

# Stratified Split for Validation
print("Splitting data...")
X_train_subset, X_val, y_train_subset, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_norm, y_train_int, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_int
)

# Initialize and Train Ensemble Models
print("Training Random Forest...")
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=0,
)
rf_model.fit(X_train_subset, y_train_subset)

print("Training Gradient Boosting...")
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=4,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    random_state=42,
)
gb_model.fit(X_train_subset, y_train_subset)

print("Training Extra Trees...")
et_model = ExtraTreesClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=123,
    verbose=0,
)
et_model.fit(X_train_subset, y_train_subset)

# Evaluate on Validation Set with Weighted Ensemble
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
rf_probs = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val)
gb_probs = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val)
et_probs = et_model.predict_proba(X_val)

# Calculate weights inversely proportional to validation log loss
rf_logloss = log_loss(y_val, rf_probs)
gb_logloss = log_loss(y_val, gb_probs)
et_logloss = log_loss(y_val, et_probs)

print(f"RF Validation Log Loss: {rf_logloss:.6f}")
print(f"GB Validation Log Loss: {gb_logloss:.6f}")
print(f"ET Validation Log Loss: {et_logloss:.6f}")

# Assign weights (inverse log loss weighting)
total_inv_ll = 1 / rf_logloss + 1 / gb_logloss + 1 / et_logloss
rf_weight = (1 / rf_logloss) / total_inv_ll
gb_weight = (1 / gb_logloss) / total_inv_ll
et_weight = (1 / et_logloss) / total_inv_ll

print(
    f"RF Weight: {rf_weight:.4f}, GB Weight: {gb_weight:.4f}, ET Weight: {et_weight:.4f}"
)

# Weighted average probabilities
avg_probs = rf_weight * rf_probs + gb_weight * gb_probs + et_weight * et_probs
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, avg_probs)
print(f"Validation Multi-Class Log Loss (3-Model Ensemble): {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate Test Predictions with Same Weighting
print("Generating submission...")
rf_test_preds = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test_norm)
gb_test_preds = gb_model.predict_proba(X_test_norm)
et_test_preds = et_model.predict_proba(X_test_norm)
test_preds = (
    rf_weight * rf_test_preds + gb_weight * gb_test_preds + et_weight * et_test_preds
)

# Prepare Submission DataFrame
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(test_preds, index=test_ids, columns=classes_order)
submission_df.rename_axis("id", inplace=True)
submission_df.to_csv(f"{OUTPUT_DIR}/submission.csv")

print("Submission saved successfully.")
